mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months are followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM are followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a falling payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term between UNRATE and PAYEMS is not significantly negative in predicting 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime where GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and housing starts (HOUST) are declining signals a demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of GDPC1 YoY < 2% and declining HOUST is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term between GDPC1 growth and HOUST changes is not significantly negative in predicting 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2% YoY) and tightening monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%), the S&P 500 forward returns are expected to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and FEDFUNDS > 1.5% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS is not significantly negative in predicting 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05).
